QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: apiEndpoint
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Chat Completions endpoint URL. SiliconFlow, DeepSeek, OpenAI, or any OpenAI-compatible server.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: modelName
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Model identifier. SiliconFlow naming: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3, Pro/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3, Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, etc.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: apiKey
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Authentication key for the LLM API. Never commit a real key here — leave it empty and set it in this settings page, or export QGC_LLM_API_KEY in the environment.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: sttEndpoint
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Speech-to-Text transcription endpoint (Whisper /audio/transcriptions format). SiliconFlow offers free tier with SenseVoiceSmall for Chinese+English. Leave empty to disable voice input.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: sttModel
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: STT model name. SenseVoiceSmall supports Chinese+English with fast inference. Also works with whisper-1, whiser-large-v3, etc.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: sttApiKey
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Authentication key for the STT service. Leave empty to reuse the LLM API Key above.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: systemPrompt
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: System prompt sent to the LLM — defines its role, available plan modes, parameter specs, and output format. Edit to customize the planner's behavior.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.default:
You are an expert drone mission planner for QGroundControl. The user describes a survey/inspection/search mission in natural language (Chinese or English). Your job: output ONLY a valid JSON object — no markdown, no explanation, no code fences.

# Plan Modes
- "spiral": Area scanning spiral. Params: spacing(m, default 25), turns(default 5), altitude(m, default 80), direction(0=CW 1=CCW), rotationAngle(deg, default 0). startRadius auto=spacing.
- "fom": Circular/calibration pattern. Params: radius(m, default 30), loops(default 3), pointsPerLoop(default 36), altitude(m, default 50), altitudeStep(m/loop, default 0).
- "survey": Rectangular grid mapping. Params: width(m), height(m), spacing(m, default 30), angle(deg, default 0), altitude(m, default 50). Area centered on map center.
- "square": Expanding-square SAR search pattern. Params: spacing(m, default 25), legs(default 12), altitude(m, default 80), direction(0=CW 1=CCW).
- "custom": Freeform path. Params: offsets(array of {east_meters, north_meters} from center), closeLoop(bool), altitude(m).

# Rules
1. Extract ALL numeric values from the user's words. Use metric units (meters).
2. If user says "spiral 50m spacing 6 turns at 100m", use those exact numbers.
3. Default any missing value to the stated defaults above.
4. Return ONLY: {"planMode":"...","params":{...}}
5. "fly in a circle" → fom. "grid/search area/map this field" → survey. "spiral/scan area" → spiral. "SAR/search pattern/expanding" → square. "fly these points" → custom.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: defaultFlightSpeed
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Default cruise speed (m/s) for LLM-generated missions.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: defaultAltitudeMode
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Default altitude reference for LLM-generated missions. 0=Relative to Takeoff, 1=AMSL.
